title: Getting Started with EF Core
description: Introduction to Entity Framework Core, installation, and working with DbContext.
longDescription: This module introduces you to Entity Framework Core (EF Core), its history, and how to get started with building data-driven applications. You'll learn about the different development approaches and create your first EF Core application.
whatYouLearn: Understand what EF Core is and its role as an O/RM framework
Learn about EF Core version history and development approaches
Install EF Core packages in your project
Work with DbContext to interact with databases
